Selected projects

Dashboards and tools that turn production and packaging data into clearer decisions and higher throughput.

Kandil Glass

NEXUS Packaging Specification Generator

NEXUS · Kandil
≥50%less calculation time
0manual calculation errors
6pallet setups compared at once
  • Faster: one live sheet replaces hand calculations, cutting the time by at least 50%.
  • Error-free: a single set of formulas drives every number, so human calculation errors are eliminated.
  • Detailed analytics: units per container, payload efficiency and weight against the container allowance for every pallet type.
  • Better decisions: Kandil and the customer see the best configuration clearly, which leads to cost savings in packaging and freight.
  • Ready to share: pallet layout drawings plus packaging manuals exported to PDF and Word.
  • Easy to use: installable, works offline and adapts to new products and options.
Breadfast

Production Rate & Line Balance Dashboard Sandwiches & Salads

  • Two factories, one view: Sandwiches (10 products) and Salads (7) with planned vs real hours, productivity (PMH) and shift efficiency.
  • Losses made visible: efficiency of 81–83% (Sandwiches) and 68–74% (Salads) means 1–1.5 h of unplanned time per shift, every day.
  • Line balance: station times expose bottlenecks (Turkey & Cheese: 230 s) and show how to reallocate workers for higher output with the same crew.
